action_items: Real provider credentials, Gemini OAuth, and live search remain unavailable by environment design; MOCK Statx Demo was used for chat verification.

checks.criterion: User can register or log in and reach the Statx dashboard
checks.name: auth-dashboard-registration
checks.evidence: Fresh registration submitted; redirected to /app; dashboard heading 'Good to see you.' and Connected AI stat were visible.

checks.name: statx-routes-sidebar-render
checks.evidence: Sidebar navigation reached /workspace, /conversations, /providers, /documents, /competency, /results, /assessment, and /settings; main content was non-empty on each route.

checks.criterion: Provider dashboard separates selection from authorization
checks.name: provider-selection-authorization-boundary
checks.evidence: Provider cards and status dots rendered; OpenAI selection showed 'In routing'; Gemini remained 'Not connected' after connect attempt. Expected 503 for missing OAuth was observed and no false connected state appeared.

checks.name: chat-thread-persists-provider-context
checks.evidence: Fresh thread accepted a prompt, displayed the prompt and demo provider attribution, changed the conversation title, and retained the prompt after reload.

checks.criterion: Search controls are visible and honest
checks.name: workspace-search-mode-honesty
checks.evidence: Auto, Web, and AI only controls were visible; Web mode showed 'Live web search' context and live-sources placeholder without claiming retrieved sources.

checks.criterion: Protected access and logout behave safely
checks.name: protected-access-logout-boundary
checks.evidence: Sign out returned to /login; direct /app navigation while unauthenticated redirected to /login and dashboard was absent. Expected 401 responses were observed.

checks.criterion: Auth API supports registration, session identity, logout, and login
checks.name: test_tscheck_auth
checks.evidence: pytest HTTP assertions passed: POST /api/auth/register 200; GET /api/auth/me 200; logout then /me 401; POST /api/auth/login 200.

checks.criterion: Provider API separates selection from authorization
checks.name: test_tscheck_providers
checks.evidence: pytest HTTP assertions passed: GET /api/providers 200; PATCH /api/providers/preferences 200; Gemini connect returned expected 503 with not-configured response.

checks.criterion: Chat API persists context and provider attribution
checks.name: test_tscheck_chat
checks.evidence: pytest HTTP assertions passed: conversation creation 200; message creation 200 with provider_id demo; conversation detail 200 containing user and assistant rows.

checks.criterion: Protected API data rejects unauthenticated access
checks.name: test_tscheck_protected
checks.evidence: pytest HTTP assertions passed: unauthenticated GET /api/conversations 401, GET /api/providers 401, and GET /api/auth/me after logout 401.

checks.criterion: Search API does not claim Web success without credential
checks.name: test_tscheck_search
checks.evidence: pytest HTTP assertion passed: Web-mode message request returned expected 503 containing search_unavailable.
